setup: The graph of \(f\) contains the point \(([[point_x]], [[point_y]])\), so the graph of \(f^{-1}\) contains \(([[point_y]], [[point_x]])\).

steps.say: For the line of slope one through the point, the reflected line has y-intercept [[inverse_intercept]].

answer: The inverse swaps the coordinates, so the asked value is one of [[inverse_value]], [[original_value]] and [[inverse_intercept]].
